3-alarming-reasons-to-clean-your-ac-befo.title: 3 Alarming Reasons to Clean Your AC Before Summer
3-alarming-reasons-to-clean-your-ac-befo.description: Regular AC cleaning before summer is essential to protect your family’s health, improve efficiency, and reduce energy costs. Dust, mold, and bacteria buildup can harm air quality and trigger respiratory issues, while clogged filters and coils force the unit to work harder, increasing electricity usage. Professional cleaning ensures cleaner air, better cooling performance, and lower utility bills.
